title: Responsive Symphony wordmark

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Let the identity change over time because a live performance should feel active rather than fixed.
strategic_value: Independent letter growth can make the Symphony name an expression of musical energy.
demonstration: White SFSYMPHONY letters on black expand at different rates, vary in height and settle into a large wordmark.
practical_value: Judge whether the name remains recognizable throughout a range of letter heights.

content_islands.name: Animated name
content_islands.spec: Keep the white serif name as the only focal element on the black field; preserve its progression from small to large.

reference_purposes.Expression: White SFSYMPHONY letters on black expand at different rates, vary in height and settle into a large wordmark.
reference_purposes.Intent: The main case-study text says variable typography brings the dynamic qualities of classical music into the identity.
